```{r setup, include=FALSE}

#Import Packages
library(flexdashboard)
library(knitr)
library(rsconnect)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)

library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(openintro)
library(highcharter)

library(DT)
library(gt)
#
```

```{r}
#Import Data

 LFdata <- read_excel("LF_July_22.xlsx")
#

df <- LFdata %>% mutate(Age_group = case_when(
  age < 10 ~ "<10",
  age >= 10 & age <= 19 ~ "10-19",
  age >= 20 & age <= 29 ~ "20-29",
  age >= 30 & age <= 40 ~ "30-40",
  age > 40 ~ ">40",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_))

```

Row 
---------------------------------
#####

```{r}
library(gtsummary)
# Basic Info



basic_table <-
  df %>%
  tbl_summary(
    include = c(consent, site),
    label = list(
      consent ~ "consent",
      site ~ "site"
    ),
    statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
    missing = "ifany"
  ) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  italicize_levels() %>%
  modify_caption("**Basic Summary**") %>%
  as_gt()
basic_table



```


#### 

```{r}
#----
prev <- df %>% group_by(site, sex, Age_group,keea_communities, gomoa_west_communities) %>%
  summarise( Prev = mean(fts_test_result== "Positive", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop")

#----
prev_sex_age_plot <- prev %>% filter(!is.na(Age_group),!is.na(sex),!is.na(site),!is.na(Prev))


#      sink("Prevalence_results.doc")


# Plot--------------------Keea_communities--------------------------------------
prev_sex_age_plot <- prev %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(Age_group),
    Age_group != 0.00,
    !is.na(sex),
    !is.na(keea_communities),
    !is.na(Prev),
    Prev > 0
  )

p1 <- ggplot(prev_sex_age_plot,
       aes(Age_group, Prev, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Prev)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = 1.0,
    size = 3.0
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~keea_communities) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Male" = "#1F77B4",
      "Female" = "#E377E2"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "KEEA_District",
    x = "Age group",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_grey() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank()
  )
# Plot--------------------Gomoa_West_communities--------------------------------
df <- LFdata %>% 
  mutate(
    Age_group = case_when(
      age < 10 ~ "<10",
      age >= 10 & age <= 19 ~ "10-19",
      age >= 20 & age <= 29 ~ "20-29",
      age >= 30 & age <= 40 ~ "30-40",
      age > 40 ~ ">40",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
prev_sex_age_plot <- prev %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(Age_group),
    Age_group != 0.00,
    !is.na(sex),
    !is.na(gomoa_west_communities),
    !is.na(Prev),
    Prev > 0
  )
#
p2 <- ggplot(prev_sex_age_plot,
       aes(Age_group, Prev, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Prev)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = 1.0,
    size = 3.0
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~gomoa_west_communities) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Male" = "#1F77B4",
      "Female" = "#E377C2"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Gomoa.West_District",
    x = "Age group",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_grey() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank()
  )
#

p1 / p2
```

## KEEA_Municipal - Malaria & QFAT {width = 100%}
 
```{r}
#KEEA_Municipal
community_table <- LFdata %>%
  filter(site != "Gomoa West District") %>%
  group_by(site, keea_communities, keea_facilities) %>%
  summarise(
    Malaria_Tested = n(),
    Malaria_Positives = sum(malaria_t_results == "Positive", na.rm = TRUE),
    Malaria_Pct = paste0(round(100 * Malaria_Positives / Malaria_Tested, 1), "%"),
    FTS_Tested = sum(!is.na(fts_test_result)),
    FTS_Positives = sum(fts_test_result == "Positive", na.rm = TRUE),
    FTS_Pct = paste0(round(100 * FTS_Positives / FTS_Tested, 1), "%"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(
    site,
    keea_communities,
    keea_facilities,
    Malaria_Tested,
    Malaria_Positives,
    Malaria_Pct,
    FTS_Tested,
    FTS_Positives,
    FTS_Pct
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(FTS_Positives))

kable(community_table, align = "c")

```
